scientific_role: consumed-history mechanism translation diagnostic; may only decide whether a fixed candidate merits later truly new-period validation

inherits.decision_universe_and_future_label: v3.3: current quiet decision rows, no first-tail in prior 30m, half-session minute 31..105, future quiet_first_tail in t+2..t+15

conditioning_algorithm.standardization: within each 2022-2023 exact group, divide coordinate differences by the calibration-library population standard deviation; floor each scale at 1e-8
conditioning_algorithm.neighbors: 100 nearest historical library rows by Euclidean distance; deterministic stable tie-break by year, session, day
conditioning_algorithm.conditional_score: midrank percentile of the evaluation row primary_scale_score among the 100 neighbor primary_scale_score values
conditioning_algorithm.insufficient_group_rule: if an exact group has fewer than 100 historical rows, the decision row is unavailable; do not widen clock/half-session group

state_support_diagnostic.purpose: detect evaluation-state extrapolation without deleting unfavorable outcomes
state_support_diagnostic.calibration_reference: for every 2022-2023 library row, compute distance to its 100th nearest OTHER row in the same exact group using the same scales
state_support_diagnostic.evaluation_extrapolated: evaluation row 100th-neighbor distance exceeds its group support limit
state_support_diagnostic.candidate_support_requirement: extrapolated decision-row fraction <= 5% separately in 2024 and 2025

comparators.raw_scale_gate: v3.3 frozen result retained as prior comparator; do not retune or overwrite
comparators.common_volatility: same v3.3 historical groupwise 80th-percentile log_sigma_pre gate, recomputed only as an identity check from 2022-2023 labels-blind calibration

event_metrics: frozen quiet-first events with any eligible strict prewindow decision
event recall from any risk decision in [e-15,e-2]
median maximum strict lead among hits
prewindow support fraction and complete-prewindow subset

random_reference.method: same v3.3 half-session alarm-sequence permutation within evaluation year and morning/afternoon class

candidate_for_future_locked_validation_o: conditional risk-Clean future-label difference is positive in both 2024 and 2025
continuous conditional-score AUC > 0.5 in both 2024 and 2025
event recall is not below the session-permutation median in either evaluation year
evaluation-state extrapolated fraction <= 5% in both evaluation years
decision_rule.if_failed: stop this V3.2 scale-score route; do not scan new K, percentiles, distance dimensions, or alternative thresholds on 2024/2025
decision_rule.if_passed: freeze exactly this candidate and wait for explicitly authorized truly new-period data; consumed-history results still cannot validate or deploy it

do_not: change the frozen V3.2 scale score
add morphology variables after reading v3.3
use 2024/2025 labels in neighbor selection, scaling, support limits, or threshold construction
use evaluation-year controls or future quiet status to build historical neighbors
drop extrapolated, missing, session-boundary, or adverse evaluation rows after seeing labels
